title: The Town That Couldn't Stop Dancing
text:
In July 1518 in Strasbourg, Frau Troffea began dancing in the street. Within a week about 34 people had joined her, and some accounts put the number at around 400 within a month. The authorities built a stage and hired musicians, believing more dancing would cure it. Historians still debate the deaths; a leading explanation is mass psychogenic illness in a town hit by famine and disease.

Comment your theory below.

Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dancing_plague_of_1518
